questions.question: Which supplier has the highest total PO spend this year, and how much?
questions.answer:
**Apex Industrial Metals (S01) has the highest PO spend this year: $486,381.54 across 39 POs** (2026-01-08 to 2026-09-25). That is close to twice the next supplier:

| Rank | Supplier | POs | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | S01 Apex Industrial Metals | 39 | $486,381.54 |
| 2 | S02 Northline Polymers | 19 | $256,787.52 |
| 3 | S05 Swift Freight Partners | 33 | $251,585.30 |

All of S01's POs are under contract C01. By quarter, S01 spend was $178,113.41 in Q1, $146,183.68 in Q2 and $162,084.45 in Q3. Its largest POs are PO-10032 and PO-10192 ($23,700 each) and PO-10037 ($20,145).

**Compliance issues found along the way.** Three S01 POs are priced above the C01 contract, for $2,740.59 in overcharges. All three are recorded and verified:
- **F-001, PO-10151:** cold-rolled steel sheet (DM-1010) at $1,279.80/ton against the contract's $1,185.00, 15 tons. Overcharge: $1,422.00.
- **F-002, PO-10055:** stainless tube (DM-1031) at $24.62/ft against $22.80, 613 ft. Overcharge: $1,115.66.
- **F-003, PO-10082:** the same stainless tube at $23.71/ft against $22.80, 223 ft. Overcharge: $202.93.

C01 fixes prices for the whole term, and any change needs a written amendment. It also says invoices above the contract price get short-paid. Before these POs are paid, check that the invoices were paid at contract price.

**Rebates on C01 are in order.** C01 pays a 2% rebate in any quarter where spend is over $150,000:
- **Q1:** rebate earned, and it was credited ($3,562.27, CR-001).
- **Q2:** spend was under the threshold, so no rebate was owed.
- **Q3:** spend went over the threshold, so a rebate of about $3,240 is owed. That credit isn't due until 2026-10-30, so it's worth tracking.

questions.question: How many invoices has Keystone MRO Supply sent us?
questions.answer:
Keystone MRO Supply (supplier S03) has sent us **29 invoices** between 2026-01-19 and 2026-09-22, totaling **$37,486.56**. Two of those are duplicates, so they cover only **27 separate POs**.

All 29 invoices are under contract C03, and each one matches its PO on quantity and unit price. Going through them turned up four problems, which I've recorded as findings. All four were checked against the data and confirmed.

**Duplicate invoices: $2,595.60 at risk**
- **F-001:** INV-500065 (2026-04-07) and INV-500220 (2026-04-10) both bill PO-10065 for $837.20.
- **F-002:** INV-500188 (2026-08-31) and INV-500218 (2026-09-01) both bill PO-10188 for $1,758.40.

**PO prices above the C03 contract: $288.51 at risk**
The contract fixes prices for its full term and says any change needs a signed written amendment.
- **F-003:** PO-10090 buys 15 × MRO-207 at $70.95, against a contract price of $64.50. That's $96.75 over. Invoice INV-500090 billed the same higher price.
- **F-004:** PO-10107 buys 204 × MRO-311 at $8.79, against a contract price of $7.85. That's $191.76 over. Invoice INV-500107 billed the same higher price.

Altogether, **$2,884.11** is at risk on Keystone invoices. If either duplicate has already been paid, ask Keystone for a refund or credit. Also confirm whether any written amendment allowed the two price increases. C03 has no volume rebate, so no rebate is owed.

questions.question: What is the contracted unit price for item MRO-311?
questions.answer:
The contracted price for MRO-311 (Ball bearing 6205-2RS) is **$7.85 each**. It comes from contract **C03** with Keystone MRO Supply (S03), which runs from 2025-01-01 to 2027-12-31. The contract says prices are fixed for the whole term and can only change through a written amendment signed by the Procurement Director. MRO-311 is not listed in the other MRO contract, C08 (Ironclad Safety Products).

**Compliance issue found:** I checked every PO for MRO-311 against that price. Nine of the ten are at $7.85: PO-10002, PO-10058, PO-10084, PO-10095, PO-10137, PO-10156, PO-10188, PO-10206 and PO-10220. The tenth, **PO-10107**, is priced at **$8.79 each** for 204 units. That is **$191.76** over the contract price (204 × $0.94). I recorded it as finding **F-001**, and the check confirmed the amount.

C03 says invoices above the contracted price get short-paid down to that price. The buyer should make sure payment on PO-10107 is limited to $7.85 per unit, or ask Keystone for a $191.76 credit. I haven't checked the invoice for this PO.

questions.question: When does the Brightway Facility Services contract expire?
questions.answer:
The Brightway Facility Services contract (C04) already expired on **June 30, 2026**, three months before the audit date of 2026-09-30. It ran from July 1, 2024. Section 1 of the contract says renewal is not automatic and any extension had to be signed by both parties before that date. No extension is on file.

**Compliance issue:** We kept raising purchase orders under C04 after it expired. I found 4 of them, worth **$31,950** in total. All 4 are recorded and verified:

| Finding | PO | PO date | Item | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-001 | PO-10162 | 2026-07-06 | FAC-100 janitorial (monthly) | $9,400 |
| F-002 | PO-10186 | 2026-08-03 | FAC-100 janitorial (monthly) | $9,400 |
| F-003 | PO-10202 | 2026-08-19 | FAC-110 HVAC maintenance, 3 visits | $3,750 |
| F-004 | PO-10217 | 2026-09-02 | FAC-100 janitorial (monthly) | $9,400 |

All 4 POs were at the old contract prices ($9,400 per month and $1,250 per visit). So the risk isn't overbilling. The risk is that this spend has no contract behind it: the prices are no longer locked in and the other contract protections no longer apply. The 9 Brightway POs dated before July 1, 2026 were within the contract term.

**Next steps:** Brightway is still doing both services, so the contract needs to be renewed or put out to bid. Until that's done, new POs shouldn't reference C04.

questions.question: What are the payment terms in contract C07?
questions.answer:
Contract C07 with CloudPeak Software (IT & Software) has **net 60** payment terms. Payment is due 60 days after Granite Ridge receives a correct invoice (Section 3).

A few related conditions in the contract:
- **What counts as a correct invoice:** it must reference a valid Granite Ridge PO number, and it can't exceed the PO's quantity or price (Section 3).
- **Overbilling:** if an invoice is above the contract unit price, it gets short-paid down to that price (Section 2). The contract prices are IT-701 ERP user license at $85.00 per seat per month and IT-705 Premium support at $1,800.00 per month. These prices are fixed for the whole term and don't include sales tax.
- **No early-payment discount and no volume rebate** (Section 4).
- **Term:** 2025-02-01 to 2028-01-31, so it's active as of the audit date. It doesn't renew automatically.

I only read the contract and didn't check C07's POs or invoices, so I haven't recorded any findings. If you want, I can check C07 invoices against these terms next.

questions.question: What rebate percentage and quarterly threshold does contract C01 have?
questions.answer:
Contract C01 (Apex Industrial Metals, supplier S01) pays a **2% rebate** on the quarter's total purchases, but only when that quarter's purchases are **more than $150,000**. Apex must issue the credit within 30 days after the quarter ends. This comes from the contract's rebate clause.

I also checked C01's 2026 rebates against the PO data. None are missed, so I recorded no findings.

| Quarter | Purchases on C01 POs | Rebate earned? | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026 Q1 | $178,113.41 (12 POs) | Yes: $3,562.27 | Credited in full by credit CR-001 on 2026-04-15 |
| 2026 Q2 | $146,183.68 (13 POs) | No: below $150,000 | None owed |
| 2026 Q3 | $162,084.45 (14 POs) | Yes: $3,241.69 | Not overdue: credit due by 2026-10-30, after today's audit date |

To act on: check that Apex issues the $3,241.69 credit for Q3 by **October 30, 2026**.

These totals add up the C01 PO amounts by PO date. I didn't measure purchases from invoices instead.
